column1: include|To have something as part of a group or activity.|Please include your name on the drawing.
allow|To let someone do something.|The rules allow us to take turns.
require|To need something.|Plants require water to grow.
choose|To pick the one you want.|You can choose a book to read.
create|To make something new.|We will create a picture together.
help|To make something easier for someone.|Please help me carry these books.
need|To have to have something.|I need a coat because it is cold.
